content:
dante: heads-up: need final internal RN + pin for RC-2026.2. proposing Wed 23:30 UTC -> Thu 02:30 UTC change window to cover APAC late traffic. canary plan still ok?
rachael: sounds fine. just want the RN to call out the gated backfill and the feature-flag default-off for initial canary.
tom: agree. also add a short rollback checklist: metrics, feature-flag flip, and DB backfill abort step. keeps oncall clear.
linh: can we also list expected short-term metrics blips so support knows what to ignore? e.g., small p95 jitter during KV warmup and transient 429s for a minute if backfill spikes.
dante: good call. i'll draft the snippet below.
dante: ```
Internal release notes: RC-2026.2 (change window Wed 23:30 UTC -> Thu 02:30 UTC)
- Summary: fixes to runtime batching and routing. adds DB backfill for job metadata (backfill gated by feature flag, default off for canary).
- Expected behavior during canary: brief KV/prefix warmup may increase p50/p95 by ~15-30ms; backfill throttling may produce short-lived 429 if unexpectedly saturated.
- Migration notes: online migration with backfill. aborting backfill: flip feature-flag and run `select count(*) from job_metadata where migrated = false` to verify.
- Rollback criteria: automated rollback if error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency up by >120ms for 5m. manual rollback steps: flip flag, divert traffic to previous routing bundle, and trigger migration pause job (runbook link pinned).
- Evacuation lane: if model-serving OOMs appear, fallback to rv1-small and pause rollout.
- Who to notify: @tom (infra), @linh (runtime), oncall ops-ambassador.
```
rachael: tiny edit: change "abort backfill" to "pause backfill" (we have a safer pause workflow).
dante: updated.
ops-bot: calendar_event_created: RC-2026.2 change window Wed 2026-03-25T23:30:00Z -> Thu 2026-03-26T02:30:00Z. reminder: 30m pre-notice.
deploy-bot: schedule: RC-2026.2 -> staging 2026-03-25T16:30:00Z. prod canary plan: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 100% with 8m evaluation pauses. id=dpl-5852-rc2026.
tom: i'll set the step-completion pings and a 30m pre-start in #eng-releases. also pre-lock the feature-flag to default-off for canary.
linh: adding short support FAQ to the RN: what to expect and who to contact. will paste in after pin.
dante: pinning RN now and tagging owner: rachael. please confirm and i'll move forward if no objections by EOD UTC.
rachael: confirmed owner. no objections from runtime.
tom: infra thumbs up.
deploy-bot: canary_initiated: RC-2026.2 -> prod 0.5% at 2026-03-25T23:30:00Z (dpl-5852-rc2026).
